qa.browser_qa_note: Freshly rebuilt output was checked at 1600x1000, 1512x982, and 390x844. The article has exactly six semantic H2 sections, a working desktop rail and mobile TOC, no page-level horizontal overflow, centered figures, and internally scrolling tables and code. The embedded deck hid the standalone return control and advanced from slide 1 to 2. The standalone deck passed button, Arrow/Home, direct hash, overview Escape, browser fullscreen entry and Escape exit, mobile dense-slide fit checks, and stable return-to-article after direct hash navigation. Article focus mode exited by both Escape and its visible exit button. The only observed console issue before the final deck favicon patch was a harmless standalone favicon 404; the data favicon removes that request.
